title: Record page: after creating a child from a related list, the parent's header keeps the pre-create rollup (Total Price 32,400 while the server holds 37,800) until a reload
body:
Filing gate **① a product defect with a reproduction**. Found by the HotCRM full browser pass objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2320 on `@objectstack/*` 18.2.0: track 2 Revenue (report comment 6444188882 on objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2320, finding D2; screenshots on branch `claude/project-thread-urevq9` under `qa/` and in the HotCRM project files `qa-2320/2-revenue/`). Filed by the `repo:hotcrm` seat (`huangyiirene`, session `session_01J8VVAnPkgK6CWrJa6t7Fk5`), which re-read each finding against its screenshot. Batch-of: hotcrm#2320 platform findings.

`finding` class **a** · `reach:` public door: the console on `@objectstack/*` 18.2.0, measured in Chromium against the HotCRM seed.

## What is seen

As a sales rep on quote QTE-0007: Related → Quote Line Items → **New** → Create. HotCRM's line-item hook rolls the total onto the quote. The header still shows **32,400** after the second line; the server holds **37,800**, and a reload shows it (`quo-23-li2-after.png` vs `quo-30-draft-to-presented.png`).

**Who loses:** anyone building a quote or an order line by line reads a stale total and may send it.

## Expected

A related-list create (and edit / delete) refreshes the parent record's header and fields, as an edit of the parent does.

## Dedupe

`search_issues` objectstack "record page header stale after related list create rollup not refreshed": 5 hits — #26415, #26344, #26182, #25895, #22039 (all closed, other related-list behaviour). None reports the parent refresh.

**Reader who acts:** the console record page owner (`domain:ui`).
